exact: negative regulation of blood/brain barrier permeability
narrow: inhibition of maintenance of permeability of BBB
inhibition of maintenance of permeability of blood-brain barrier

definition: Any process that decreases blood-brain barrier permeability, the quality of the blood-brain barrier that allows for a controlled passage of substances (e.g. macromolecules, small molecules, ions) into and out of the brain.
label: negative regulation of blood-brain barrier permeability
